Lucida, as a service, is a music ripper with an emphasis of ease of access, and accessibility as a whole. It's meant to be a merge of the teams from DoubleDouble and Slav Art, both the site and the Discord/Telegram bot having the goal of providing music for free. Getting rid of the bad and keeping the good, Lucida was born.

This site essentially functions as a wrapper of the Lucida downloader library written in TypeScript.

Since this is in beta, as I write this we plan to support all of the services supported by DoubleDouble currently.
You can see a complete list of sites we are planning to add over here.
However, we are never adding Bandcamp, because Bandcamp is primarily used by independent artists. Just wait for a Bandcamp Friday to get your songs.

We thought you should know what data we collect, how we collect it and why we do it.

We use a self-hosted Plausible Analytics instance to track how users are learning about our site. This is stored permanently but nothing identifiable is recorded, and is visible to anyone here. What is stored is your basic location from your IP (country), user agent, referrer, and where you go on our site.

Internally, we also temporarily store data about you and your downloads for a few reasons. At absolute minimum, we store what you input on our site, and if your download errors. We do this for a few reasons - mainly to combat abuse and just to generally serve you the downloads you want.
To provide functionality (kept for only a few seconds, for requests)
To track failures of downloads (kept indefinitely)
